ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark charcoal) to high-intensity (off-white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe displays a large, contiguous high-intensity mottled region across the upper two-thirds, extending from the notch toward the distal tip. The right lobe is predominantly low-intensity with a concentrated cluster of high-intensity pixels at the distal tip and scattered focal spots in the lower-right quadrant. The central peduncle area is uniform low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire continuous linear boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations increases significantly at the distal tips, showing irregular peaks and valleys against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear sweep from the notch transitioning to a moderate convex curve along the mid-lobe section, concluding in a sharp upward-tapering distal tip on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of circular, high-contrast pixel rings localized on the outer margin of the right lobe; secondary group of isolated circular markers visible on the upper-left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of fine, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) situated in the middle-right quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable barnacle colonization or heavy scarring at the distal margins, particularly prominent on the far right tip, resulting in a jagged, irregular pixel boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'mask-like' pigmentation pattern on the left lobe characterized by high-intensity interconnected mottled blobs against a dark background.
